thread:
jamie (partnerships): quick heads-up — we're planning a light API handshake change next Tue (2026-06-15). minimal: new request header `X-Redwood-Version: v2` for explicit v2 routing. need partner coordination so integrations don't break.
li (eng): thanks. can you confirm behavior when header is missing? fallback to v1 or 426?
sam (devex): we should default to v1 for a 30-day migration window, but return `Warning` header and a telemetry event. partners get opt-in preview this week.
katie (partners): i'll flag top 10 partners (marketplace & SI) and ask for quick smoke tests. do we have a short checklist I can send?
li (eng): checklist draft: 1) send requests with `X-Redwood-Version: v2` 2) validate streaming works (chunking unchanged) 3) confirm auth/token flows unchanged 4) check SDKs for header injection (client libs will have a minor bump) 5) run inference samples against marketplace staging. i'll paste a curl snippet:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Redwood-Version: v2" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
maria (marketplace): for marketplace listings, we'll need partners to upload a compatibility badge and a short note about supported API versions. timeline?
jamie (partnerships): opt-in preview opens Fri, public toggle Tue (same day as change), full enforcement (reject missing header) after 30 days. marketplace announcement to be coordinated — don't publish breaking notice until day-of toggle.
katie (partners): i'll coordinate partner calls Wed/Thu next week. recommend sending sample SDK patches for them to try.
sam (devex): SDK plan: patch clients to set `X-Redwood-Version` automatically when user calls `client.setApiVersion('v2')` — publish rc to npm/pypi simultaneously with opt-in. also include a compatibility test in `redwood-integration-check` CI.
li (eng): another ask: hardware partners that integrate at the inference protocol layer may need to handle KV cache metadata changes. i'll add a note in the PR.
jamie (partnerships): good call — @maria can you loop in marketplace partner ops to hold a small partner-facing test window? also want an internal embargoed brief for joint-announcement partners.
maria (marketplace): yes, looping them now. we prefer a joint blog + release note, but we'll only publish partner names after they opt-in.
sam (devex): mini runbook for partners: how to enable preview, smoke test steps, how to report issues (status.redwood.ai/incidents or ping #partnerships). I'll draft and share by EOD.
li (eng): dev note: server will log `api_version_header` events; we'll add a migration dashboard in Console under 'Partner integrations' -> 'Version adoption'.
jamie (partnerships): great — last item: partners with contractual SLA constraints (enterprise/dedicated) — legal/product to send tailored timelines. @katie can you flag those?
katie (partners): on it. i'll include calendar invites for migration calls.
deploy-bot: scheduled opt-in toggle job created: `toggle/api-version-preview/2026-06-11T17:00Z` — will post status when run. :gear:
jamie (partnerships): thanks everyone. next sync Fri 0900 PT after preview opens. if any partner says they need more time, escalate here and we'll propose a phased gating approach. :pray:
